mapper.select: SELECT id, revision, state, package_key, plan_sha256, create_copy, import_count, skip_count, created_at, committed_at FROM knowledge_package WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id}

SELECT id, revision, state, package_key, plan_sha256, create_copy, import_count, skip_count, created_at, committed_at FROM knowledge_package WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND package_key=#{packageKey} AND create_copy=FALSE

SELECT ordinal, source_id, source_sha256, source_bytes, source_characters, kind, decision, title, tags_json, aliases_json, topic_ids_json, item_id, version_id FROM knowledge_package_entry WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND package_id=#{id} ORDER BY ordinal
SELECT ordinal, source_id, attachment_id, source_sha256 FROM knowledge_package_attachment WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND package_id=#{id} ORDER BY ordinal
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_package (id, owner_id, revision, state, package_key, original_key, plan_sha256, create_copy, import_count, skip_count, created_at, committed_at) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{owner}, #{row.revision}, #{row.state}, #{row.packageKey}, CASE WHEN #{row.createCopy}=FALSE THEN #{row.packageKey} ELSE NULL END, #{row.planSha256}, #{row.createCopy}, #{row.importCount}, #{row.skipCount}, #{row.createdAt}, #{row.committedAt})

INSERT INTO knowledge_package_entry (owner_id, package_id, ordinal, source_id, source_sha256, source_bytes, source_characters, kind, decision, title, tags_json, aliases_json, topic_ids_json, item_id, version_id) VALUES (#{owner}, #{id}, #{row.ordinal}, #{row.sourceId}, #{row.sourceSha256}, #{row.sourceBytes}, #{row.sourceCharacters}, #{row.kind}, #{row.decision}, #{row.title}, #{row.tagsJson}, #{row.aliasesJson}, #{row.topicIdsJson}, #{row.itemId}, #{row.versionId})

INSERT INTO knowledge_package_attachment (owner_id, package_id, ordinal, source_id, attachment_id, source_sha256) VALUES (#{owner}, #{id}, #{row.ordinal}, #{row.sourceId}, #{row.attachmentId}, #{row.sourceSha256})
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_package SET revision=revision+1, state='COMMITTED', committed_at=#{now} WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id} AND state='REGISTERED' AND revision=#{revision}
